newsitem.title: USA: Dun & Bradstreet names two executives.
newsitem.headline: Dun & Bradstreet names two executives.

text.p: MURRAY HILL, N.J., July 16 (reuter) - Dun & Bradstreet Corp Wednesday named Andre Dahan as president of the Dun & Bradstreet operating company in the U.S. and Elahe Hessamfar as the company's chief information officer
The company said Dahan, formerly of Sequent Computer Systems Inc, will be responsible for the U.S. operations of the provider of the business-to-business credit, marketing and purchasing information.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to say who Dahan is replacing.

The company said Hessamfar, formerly of Turner Broadcasting System Inc, will be responsible for developing the company's technology strategy and implementing it across its three operating companies -- Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's Investors Service and Reuben H. Donnelley.
Dun & Bradstreet said Hessamfar succeeds Clifford Bateman, senior vice president and chief information officer, who is resigning to spend more time with his family in Atlanta.
Both Hessamfar and Dahan will report to chief executive Volney Taylor, the company added.

A company spokesman later said Dahan is taking over from Volney taylor as president of the Dun & Bradstreet operating company in the U.S. Taylor remains Dun & Bradstreet Corp's chief executive and chairman, he added.
